テキスト cha 390: Born Shiyo 728, December 16. Height 158cm (as of Shiyo 800). Mother of Kotaro and Eiichiro Niimura and head of the Arata settlement; she holds the highest role, Grand Witch. She greets guests with her favorite impressions, and though Haruka Niimura berates her as a 'cosplay hag' for her shameless behavior, she pays it no mind. Entertainment is apparently what matters.

At dinner her entertainer's soul catches fire, and she appears doing an impression of Erina Goto (twin-tail wig and uniform included). Everyone is speechless, and Chigaya Niimura is furious that it looks nothing like her. The mood sours, and she proposes settling it with ghost stories, the Arata-style contest. She stays dressed as Erina Goto throughout.

Whether Erika Niimura's ghost story is true is unknown, but she was originally from outside the settlement and came to the Arata settlement when she married in. Like Mifuyu Niimura, she seems to have been firmly resolved to be with a man of the Arata settlement.

Though head of a remote settlement, she is friendly and becomes friends with Natsumi Kogori and Erina Goto. Behind that she struggles: she wants to root out the settlement's gloomy temperament and evil traditions, but it is not going well. Her view: "there is no telling what moves beneath the surface." Her talk of a curse seems tied to the settlement's events of the past ten years.

Mifuyu Niimura confesses the Megasawa City affair to her, which would normally be subject to punishment. But since nothing happened in the end, she puts the punishment of Mifuyu Niimura and Sakura Niimura on hold.

She did not stop the old people from killing themselves because the previous Grand Witch ordered her never to stop anyone trying to kill themselves. She was never told the reason, and so, thinking that pondering why they killed themselves might defy the previous Grand Witch's order, she stopped thinking about it.
If there is no prospect of solving the curse-killings by the end of the thirteenth-year memorial service, she seems to intend to have the police step in.

She had been patrolling the area around the settlement, and witnessed what happened between Kotaro Niimura and the others at Arata Station. She most likely watched in silence until the end, but finally she cut off Kotaro Niimura's arm and brought the situation under control. She likely cut off her son's arm to keep Kotaro from piling up any more evil deeds.

Dies suddenly of a heart attack on May 3, Shiyo 800, at 71. A purely natural death from illness, with no foul play. She was not caught up in the baffling jinx that 'those who live in the Arata settlement die in April.'

On April 3, Shiyo 790, she isolates Chigaya Niimura, who has developed the Green-Eye Curse-Killing, in the underground storeroom. She hid her out of sight because it could have stirred the residents' suspicion; had it become known, it might have ended like the True Jusatsu Arc's 'Memory × Revenge × Tumor.' Seen that way, locking her there was the right call.

She tries to talk Sakura Niimura, who is about to throw herself off a cliff for breaking the rule, out of it and save her, but she is not strong enough and lets her fall. Right after, she learns that Kotaro Niimura has cut off Sakura's head, but saying "I couldn't save her, so it's as good as if I killed her," she keeps the fact hidden.

テキスト cha 390: Following the advice of Natsumi Kogori, who has regained her danger sense, she goes back to the settlement to get Noh masks and red robes.
古郡なつみの指示に従い、人数分の能面と赤装束を用意。住人たち全員を引き連れて糸姫山の頂上にたどり着く。新村幸太郎も能面と赤装束による防御方法に気づいていたようで、比較的スムーズに到着できたが、トンネルの穴は大人の男性には狭かったようで、穴を広げる作業に時間を費やしていた。
このような変異があったにもかかわらず、新村栄一郎の十三回忌は予定通りやると発言し顰蹙を買うも、それは息子に本当の弔いをしてあげたいという母心からであり、周囲もそれを汲んで十三回忌が執り行われることとなった。
